race.comment: PIERATA'S SPIRIT (1) gets top billing fresh in his first start for the Taylor camp, with the first-time blinkers and a solid third in a Rockhampton trial giving him the right set-up to improve. He was heavily backed when fourth at the Gold Coast before the break after beginning awkwardly, and his debut at Eagle Farm also came with an early mistake, so there is more to him than two unplaced runs suggest. PATIENCEOFASAINT (8) is the race-fit danger after going under by just over a length at Rocky six days ago, though coming back from 1300m to 1100m asks her to sharpen up. WILLOW CAPRI (9) caught the eye fresh, charging home after early interference to only be beaten 1.5L in fifth. Should have come on from that and can take closer order this time. RUM AND KIRK (2) draws ideally and had excuses when wide at Townsville. Should be handy again and can give another bold sight.
